name: dsh-cost-meter
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web plugin: hides the composer's bottom status bar and shows the session's per-model token usage, total cost (CNY + USD) and the account balance inside the context-ring panel, priced per https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing with balance per https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/api/get-user-balance
author: Polar-Lighter <polar_lighter@qq.com>
